faqs.q: Where and how are the Hercules O-ring and seal kits used?
faqs.a: Hercules O-ring and seal kits are boxed assortments of O-rings for hydraulic repair, including the 568 face kit, the 900 boss kit and metric kits for European and Japanese sizes. The listing carries 9 part numbers.

faqs.q: What sizes and part numbers are listed for the Hercules O-ring and seal kits?
faqs.a: The listing carries 9 part numbers: the 568 face kit and 568 flange kit, 568FC (fluorocarbon), the 900 boss kit, the Max 1381 kit and two metric kits, METRIC O KIT-E for European sizes and METRIC O KIT-J for Japanese sizes.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size or model of the Hercules O-ring and seal kits?
faqs.a: Choose the kit by the thread system and the contents: the 568 kits are for face-seal and flange joints, the 900 kit for boss ports and the metric kits by European or Japanese sizes. The fluorocarbon kit 568FC is for hot or aggressive fluids.

faqs.q: What pressure rating do the Hercules O-ring and seal kits have?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the Hercules O-ring and seal kits, because the pressure a seal holds depends on the thread system, the fitting and the seal material. Tell us the fitting and the working pressure and we confirm the kit.

faqs.q: Which materials are the Hercules O-ring and seal kits offered in?
faqs.a: The kits are O-ring assortments, nitrile in the standard kits and fluorocarbon in the 568FC kit, according to the item names. Fluorocarbon resists heat and many fluids better than nitrile, at a higher price.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to the Hercules O-ring and seal kits?
faqs.a: The listing names no SAE, ISO or DIN standard for the Hercules O-ring and seal kits, and the kits are listed by thread system and contents. If your project needs a material or conformity certificate, say so in the enquiry and we ask the maker what it can issue.

faqs.q: Which parts do the Hercules O-ring and seal kits mate with?
faqs.a: The Hercules O-ring and seal kits supply the seals, caps or fittings for the thread systems named in the listing, such as JIC, ORFS, ORB, BSP or metric. Match the kit to the thread system of your hose fittings and ports. See [our fitting and seal kits shelf](/c/hydraulic-fitting-seal-kits) for the other kits.

faqs.q: How should the Hercules O-ring and seal kits be installed and maintained?
faqs.a: Keep the Hercules O-ring and seal kits in the original box or pack, lubricate seals before fitting and check the seat for nicks and dirt. Use a new seal each time a fitting is remade, and do not reuse a flattened or hardened O-ring.

faqs.q: Which industries and jobs use the Hercules O-ring and seal kits?
faqs.a: The Hercules O-ring and seal kits are used by hose shops, fleet workshops and maintenance teams to keep common seals, caps and fittings on hand for repair, so a leaking joint is fixed on site.

faqs.q: How do the Hercules O-ring and seal kits differ from the Hose Box hydraulic fitting and seal kits?
faqs.a: The Hercules kits are 9 O-ring assortments for face, boss and metric joints, while [the Hose Box hydraulic fitting and seal kits](/p/hose-box-hydraulic-fitting-and-seal-kits) are 42 packs that also hold fittings, caps and seals by thread system. Choose Hercules when you only need O-rings.

faqs.q: What country of origin and HS code apply to the Hercules O-ring and seal kits?
faqs.a: We ship the Hercules O-ring and seal kits from our Dubai, UAE warehouse to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond. The country of origin depends on the plant that made the batch and is stated on the commercial invoice. Export documents come with the order; ask on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.a: Yes, the Hercules O-ring and seal kits are held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need on [our contact page](/contact).
